name: @teactjs/cli
description: CLI tool for the Teact bot framework — create, dev, build, generate

scripts.build: bun build ./src/bin.ts ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target bun --external vite --external vite-node --external esbuild --external commander --external @clack/prompts --external @teactjs/bot-templates && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json
